description: IDAAN-Listado de localización de plantas de tratamiento de agua residuales PTAR is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto de Acueductos y Alcantarillados Nacionales. En este conjunto de datos, podrás ver el listado de la localización de todas las plantas de tratamiento de aguas residuales PTAR a nivel nacional. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto de Acueductos y Alcantarillados Nacionales. Its tags are cambio climático, salud, salud pública, tratamiento de aguas residuales. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-11-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
